What was verified this turn:

- CI run [38010286522](https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/38010286522) at `c4dc4b6`, three attempts total (initial plus two failed-job reruns). Build and Swift-format lint are green on every attempt, and every agenda suite passes: Design, FitPlanner, HeightConsistency, InlineText, Model, Models, Presentation, RefreshFilter, RefreshState, Store, Visibility, EyeLine, and Placement.

Everything reads calm and deliberate in light and dark; no visual fixes were needed.
- `sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-66.5` is empty, and only this phase bead was closed. The parent epic and ancestor plan beads were not touched.

Why CI is red: each of the three identical-SHA runs fails differently, always in async-timing assertions outside this phase — a refs coalescing count, a panel-preview `waitUntil` timeout, a refs-panel reorder timeout. The implicated code is byte-identical to the green base `3d36a02` (the `3d36a02..HEAD` diff is agenda, panel-integration, settings, and agenda-test files only), these tests passed with this phase's code in place on an earlier run, and GitHub annotates degraded macOS arm64 runner capacity on every run. I recorded this as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP` on the bead suggesting timeout bumps or quarantining, plus a second one noting the epic-authorized decisions-memory record for caching/folding/eye-line policy still needs writing via the `/sase_memory_write` skill, which was not available in this session.
